versions.changelog:
- Added OpenClaw metadata block under the "metadata" section, specifying `requires.env` and `primaryEnv`.
- No changes to core features, API, or end-user functionality.

Initial release of Text-to-Speech & Voice Cloning Assistant (via Verbatik):

- Generate speech using 2700+ pre-trained voices with TTS and SSML support
- Clone custom voices from user-provided audio (MP3/WAV), with emotion, speed, and pitch controls
- Generate speech from cloned voices, including interjections and pause markers
- Manage cloned voices: list, retrieve, and delete
- Browse available voices and preview samples without authentication
- Check usage costs and prepaid account balance
